title: Native popovers anchored to controls on a tilted panel
blurb: Buttons on a panel drawn in perspective open a real popover, a hint and a modal dialog through commandfor and interestfor. CSS anchor positioning keeps each popover on its drawn button while the panel turns.
question: Do native popovers, hints and dialogs open from controls that a canvas draws in perspective, and does CSS anchor positioning place them at the drawn control?
result: Yes in Chromium 157: the anchor rectangle is the bounding box of the drawn quad and an open popover follows it as the panel turns. Chromium 153 anchors to the layout box.
